bonus.text: Ússua took shape in the early 1900s under European influence, its bands mixing accordions with drums. Men dance it in straw hats, with an embroidered towel over the arm.
Calema's 6 June 2026 stadium show in Braga was set to screen live in 26 NOS cinemas across Portugal, from the mainland to Madeira and the Azores.
Researching the islands' music, anthropologist Magdalena Bialoborska Chambel found the national radio's archive: about 2,000 tapes from the 1960s to 1990s, once thought destroyed.
